put.summary: Set the caller's own mark on a topic (idempotent; the newer edit wins). Never used by the metrics.

get.summary: The caller's records changed after the cursor, deletions included.
The caller's analysis panel; recomputed when records, profile or the day changed. Honours If-None-Match.
The caller's topic card; a topic without records returns ConfidenceLevel None.
This week's study plan with live progress; built on first read and frozen for the week. Honours If-None-Match.

post.summary: Drop an item from this week's plan; the next candidate takes its slot. Idempotent.

get.summary: Download everything the student entered as a ZIP of semicolon-separated UTF-8 CSVs. 3 per hour.
